title: Add/remove pantry and weekly-list items (one run vs recurring)
description: Easy UI to add a pantry ingredient and to remove an item from the weekly list. Every action must be scoped explicitly to one of two contexts — (1) this session only (single UI run / one-off week) or (2) the recurring weekly list template (persists for future weeks). Do not conflate the two; the UI should make the scope obvious (e.g. toggle, separate screens, or confirm when changing the template).

title: Per-week recurring overrides + UI to edit default recurring list
description: Editing the list of recurring items for a week should NOT change the moving-forward default. That per-week edit is the normal/default path during a run. Separately (not by default): provide a dedicated UI or entry point to view and edit the recurring weekly list template that persists for future weeks (config-backed recurring items). Two distinct flows: (A) per-week overrides for one session only; (B) intentional edits to the default template.

title: Output step: show added/removed items and pantry actions
description: On the existing output step that shows ingredients per recipe, also show: (1) a list of added items — from recurring items plus whatever the user pasted into extra items; (2) a list of removed items — pantry items we do not include in the final grocery list. At that step, let the user add anything else to pantry, or do a one-time (1x) removal of an item from the run (without necessarily changing pantry/template unless they choose to).

title: Edit the final grocery list before export
description: After the output/review step (per-recipe view plus added/removed lists), allow the user to edit the final consolidated grocery list (manual tweaks before export or copy).

title: Exclude section headers from copyable grocery/meals text
description: The copyable text at the end still includes the words "grocery list" and "meals" as list items. Those labels should remain section headers in the UI only, not duplicated in the exported/copyable list body.

title: Investigate and fix ambiguous parse: "2 red" on weekly list
description: This week's grocery list included a line "2 red" with no clear product (context: list also had cherry tomatoes, red onions, red-pepper flakes). Parser or recipe source may be dropping the noun (e.g. bell peppers, wine). Reproduce from current week data, identify source line, and improve parsing or display so users see a meaningful ingredient.

title: Add red pepper flakes to default pantry
description: User pantry should include red pepper flakes by default (alongside existing staples). Example list item: "pinch of red-pepper flakes" should be treated as already in pantry when appropriate.
